title.target: shuí dehuà zǒu dé gèng yuǎn

pairs.target: shàngwǔ de huòchē hái méi dào , dù chéng xiān bǎ chángzhuō cóng qiángbiān tuō le chūlái .
pairs.english: Before the morning freight carts arrived, Du Cheng dragged the long table away from the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 上午的货车还没到，杜澄先把长桌从墙边拖了出来。

pairs.target: zhuōmiàn yǒu yídào chénnián de tàng hén , zhènghǎo chuānguò tānkāi de liánhuì jiǎnbào , xiàng jiāng nà liàng sòng tóngguō de chē yòu lán le yìhuí .
pairs.english: An old scorch mark across the tabletop ran right through the unfolded association bulletin, as though stopping the cart delivering copper pots once again.
pairs.hanzi: 桌面有一道陈年的烫痕，正好穿过摊开的联会简报，像将那辆送铜锅的车又拦了一回。

pairs.target: chēfū yě lái le . tā bǎ màozi gē zài xītóu , wèn jīnrì shuō qīngchǔ yǐhòu , wǎnghòu dìng de chēcì hái zuò buzuòshù .
pairs.english: The driver had come too. He put his hat on his knees and asked whether, once things were clarified today, the journeys booked ahead would still count.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫也来了。他把帽子搁在膝头，问今日说清楚以后，往后订的车次还作不作数。

pairs.target: dǒng lǐshì ràng tā xiān bié zǒu , zìjǐ zhàn dào zhuōzi de lìngyìtóu , méiyǒu zuò nà zhāng wéiyī dài kàobèi de yǐzi .
pairs.english: Director Dong asked him not to leave yet, standing at the other end of the table herself instead of taking the only chair with a back.
pairs.hanzi: 董理事让他先别走，自己站到桌子的另一头，没有坐那张唯一带靠背的椅子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi lái jiāo shàngwǔ liáng hǎo de chǐcùn , ruǎn héng ràng tā liú yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Tavi came to hand in the morning's measurements, and Ruan Heng asked him to stay a little.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维来交上午量好的尺寸，阮衡让他留一会儿。

pairs.target: wūlǐ jǐ , yīwén yǐjīng suí shī nán zuòzài kàochuāng chù , ná zhe liǎngběn báo cè . tā tái yǎn cháo tǎ wéi dòngledòng méimáo , méi xiàng zuówǎn nàyàng zhāoshǒu .
pairs.english: The room was crowded. Iven was already seated with Shinan by the window, holding two thin notebooks. He raised his eyes and twitched his eyebrows at Tavi, without waving as he had last night.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里挤，伊文已经随施南坐在靠窗处，拿着两本薄册。他抬眼朝塔维动了动眉毛，没像昨晚那样招手。

pairs.target: zhuōshàng bǎi zhe sānfèn zhǐ . zuìzǎo de shìyùn jìlù yǒu xiāngdǐ de tú , xiě zhe hédìng de qīngzǎi ;
pairs.english: Three papers lay on the table. The earliest trial record had a diagram of the crate base and specified an approved light load;
pairs.hanzi: 桌上摆着三份纸。最早的试运记录有箱底的图，写着核定的轻载；

pairs.target: liánhuì hòulái chū de zhāiyào méiyǒu tú , què réng liú zhe qīngzǎi de zìyàng . chēfū dàilái de zhuǎnfā jiǎnbào , qiàhǎo cóng xià yìháng kāishǐ chāo , shuō fēng zhàn yǐ néng zhěngxiāng jiē xiè .
pairs.english: The association's later summary omitted the diagram but still retained the words light load. The forwarded bulletin the driver brought began copying at precisely the next line, saying Wind Trestle could now receive and unload whole crates.
pairs.hanzi: 联会后来出的摘要没有图，却仍留着轻载的字样。车夫带来的转发简报，恰好从下一行开始抄，说风栈已能整箱接卸。

pairs.target: " búshì wǒ kànlòu de . " chēfū zhǐzhe nà yìháng , shǒuzhǐ tíng dé hěn wěn .
pairs.english: “I didn't overlook it.” The driver pointed at that line, his finger perfectly steady.
pairs.hanzi: “不是我看漏的。”车夫指着那一行，手指停得很稳。

pairs.target: " shì . zhè yífèn shàng méiyǒu . " shī nán shuō . tā qǐng dù chéng jiāng shōujiàn rìqī niàn chūlái , yīwén zhú zhāng jì zàicè lǐ , yòu bǎ gè fèn zhǐ de lái chù xiě dào yè biān , bù jiāng sānzhāng diéchéng yífèn .
pairs.english: “Yes. This copy doesn't have it,” Shinan said. He asked Du Cheng to read out the dates received. Iven recorded each paper in his notebook, adding its source in the margin rather than stacking the three as one.
pairs.hanzi: “是。这一份上没有。”施南说。他请杜澄将收件日期念出来，伊文逐张记在册里，又把各份纸的来处写到页边，不将三张叠成一份。

pairs.target: dǒng lǐshì kàn le xǔjiǔ , cái shuō liánhuì yìnfā zhāiyào shí biàn bùgāi shěngdiào xiāngdǐ tú .
pairs.english: Director Dong studied them for a long time before saying the association should never have omitted the crate-base diagram when printing the summary.
pairs.hanzi: 董理事看了许久，才说联会印发摘要时便不该省掉箱底图。

pairs.target: pángbiān shāngháng de rén jiē huà , shuō tú tàixiǎo , chāo dào chuándān shàng shuí yě kànbùqīng ; tāmen zhèhuí nálái de shì zhào yuányàng zhuǎnsòng de , bìng méi jiào shuí shān .
pairs.english: The trading firm's man beside her interjected that the diagram was too small for anyone to read on a copied flyer; what they brought this time had been passed on exactly as received, and they hadn't told anyone to cut anything.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边商行的人接话，说图太小，抄到传单上谁也看不清；他们这回拿来的是照原样转送的，并没叫谁删。

pairs.target: " nà shì shuí cóng zhèlǐ qǐ chāo de ? " dù chéng wèn . shāngháng de rén bào le yígè dàibàn de xìngshì . yīwén de bǐ dùnzhù , mò zài zhǐ shàng yīn chū yígè yuándiǎn .
pairs.english: “Then who began copying here?” Du Cheng asked. The firm's man gave a broker's surname. Iven's pen stopped, and ink spread into a round dot on the paper.
pairs.hanzi:
“那是谁从这里起抄的？”杜澄问。
商行的人报了一个代办的姓氏。伊文的笔顿住，墨在纸上洇出一个圆点。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bú rènshi nà xìngshì , zhǐjiàn yīwén hěnkuài lìng qǐ yìháng , jiāng míngzì xiě quán .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't recognize the surname. He only saw Iven start a fresh line quickly and write out the full name.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维不认识那姓氏，只见伊文很快另起一行，将名字写全。

pairs.target: shī nán qǐng shāngháng bǔjiāo dàibàn shōudào de yuánjiàn , liántóng jiāo chāo rìqī yíbìng sònglái . jīnrì píng zhè sānzhāng zhǐ , hái bùnéng shuō qīng nà yìháng jiūjìng shì zài shuí shǒulǐ méi diào de .
pairs.english: Shinan asked the firm to send the original received by the broker, together with the date it was handed over for copying. These three papers alone could not establish today whose hands had lost that line.
pairs.hanzi: 施南请商行补交代办收到的原件，连同交抄日期一并送来。今日凭这三张纸，还不能说清那一行究竟是在谁手里没掉的。

pairs.target: chēfū róu le róu màoyán . " nǐmen zhǎo yuánjiàn , wǒ xiàhuí háishì lā zhè pī guō . bùnéng dào zhèlǐ , zài ràng wǒ bào zhe guò yíbiàn . "
pairs.english: The driver rubbed his hat brim. “You can look for the original. Next time I'll still be hauling these pots. You can't make me arrive here and carry them over one by one again.”
pairs.hanzi: 车夫揉了揉帽檐。“你们找原件，我下回还是拉这批锅。不能到这里，再让我抱着过一遍。”

pairs.target: nàtiān tāmen bìng méi bǎ suǒyǒu jiùzhàng suàn wán . dǒnglǐ shìxiān lièchū yǐ dìngchē cì , ràng chēxíng zhúyī quèrèn xiāngdǐ ;
pairs.english: They did not settle every old account that day. Director Dong first listed the booked journeys and had the transport firm confirm each crate base;
pairs.hanzi: 那天他们并没把所有旧账算完。董理事先列出已订车次，让车行逐一确认箱底；

pairs.target: bùhé zhècì shìyùn tiáojiàn de , fāchē qián biàn gǎichéng yuányǒu de chāi xiāng jiē xiè , lìng liú zhuāngxiè shíduàn , bù jǐjìn zhěngxiāng shìyùn de duìlǐ .
pairs.english: For those outside this trial's conditions, arrangements would change before departure to the existing unpacking method, with separate loading and unloading slots, rather than squeezing them into the whole-crate trial queue.
pairs.hanzi: 不合这次试运条件的，发车前便改成原有的拆箱接卸，另留装卸时段，不挤进整箱试运的队里。

pairs.target: dù chéng tiān shàng yào duōshǎo rén , shāngháng de rén zhuīwèn duōchū de gōngqián luò zài nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Du Cheng added how many workers were needed, and the firm's man pressed to know who would pay the extra wages.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄添上要多少人，商行的人追问多出的工钱落在哪里。

pairs.target: shuō dào zhèlǐ , wūlǐ de shēngyīn yòu gāo qǐlái . chēfū qiáncì duō děng de chēqián , shāngháng zhī kěn xiān chéngdān yíbàn , yúxià bùfen yào dàihuíqù hé .
pairs.english: At this, voices in the room rose again. The firm would initially cover only half the driver's extra waiting charge from last time; the remainder had to go back for verification.
pairs.hanzi: 说到这里，屋里的声音又高起来。车夫前次多等的车钱，商行只肯先承担一半，余下部分要带回去核。

pairs.target: chēfū bùkěn zài " jiéqīng " hòutou qiānzì , zuìhòu shuāngfāng zài pángbiān lìng xiěshí fù shù hé wèijié shù , màozi shǐzhōng liúzài tā xī shàng .
pairs.english: The driver refused to sign after “settled in full.” In the end both sides wrote the amounts paid and outstanding separately alongside it; his hat stayed on his knees throughout.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫不肯在“结清”后头签字，最后双方在旁边另写实付数和未结数，帽子始终留在他膝上。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ gēngzhèng gàoshì niàn le yíbiàn . hédìng xiāngdǐ hé xiàndìng qīngzǎi xiě zài dìyīháng , hòumiàn cái shì shìyùn qǐzhǐrìqī .
pairs.english: Iven read the corrected notice aloud once. The approved crate base and light-load restriction were on the first line, followed by the trial's start and end dates.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把更正告示念了一遍。核定箱底和限定轻载写在第一行，后面才是试运起止日期。

pairs.target: dù chéng ràng tā zài dú yícì , gé zhe mén wèn zhèngzài bān kuāng de jì huái tīng bu tīng dé qīng . jì huái shuō tīng dé qīng , zì ruò tiē dé tài gāo jiù kànbùqīng , wūlǐ yǒurén xiào le yìshēng .
pairs.english: Du Cheng had him read it again and asked Ji Huai, carrying baskets outside the door, whether he could hear clearly. Ji Huai said he could hear, but wouldn't be able to read it if they posted it too high. Someone in the room laughed.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄让他再读一次，隔着门问正在搬筐的纪槐听不听得清。纪槐说听得清，字若贴得太高就看不清，屋里有人笑了一声。

pairs.target: sànhuì hòu , tǎ wéi bāng zhe jiāng chángzhuō bānhuí qiángbiān . yīwén hái zài hé zuìhòu yíyè , děng shāngháng de rén zǒu yuǎn , cái jiāng cèzǐ hé shàng .
pairs.english: After the meeting Tavi helped move the long table back to the wall. Iven was still checking the last page, and waited until the firm's man had gone before closing the notebook.
pairs.hanzi: 散会后，塔维帮着将长桌搬回墙边。伊文还在核最后一页，等商行的人走远，才将册子合上。

pairs.target: " nàge dàibàn lái guò wǒjiā . " tā shuō , " gěi wǒ dài guò yítào qí . nà shíhòu wǒ juéde tā shénme dōu zhīdào , lián wǒ fùqīn bú ài chī nǎ zhǒng diǎnxīn dōu zhīdào . "
pairs.english: “That broker has visited my home,” he said. “He brought me a chess set. Back then I thought he knew everything, even which pastries my father didn't like.”
pairs.hanzi: “那个代办来过我家。”他说，“给我带过一套棋。那时候我觉得他什么都知道，连我父亲不爱吃哪种点心都知道。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fúzhù zhuōjiǎo , miǎnde yā dào dìshàng de zhǐ jiǎo . " nǐ fāngcái xiǎng tì tā shuōhuà ? "
pairs.english: Tavi held the table leg to keep it from crushing a paper corner on the floor. “You wanted to speak up for him just now?”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维扶住桌脚，免得压到地上的纸角。“你方才想替他说话？”

pairs.target: " xiǎng shuō tā zuòshì hěn zǐxì . " yīwén yòng zhǐjiǎ guāqù bǐgǎn shàng yìdiǎn gān mò ,
pairs.english: “I wanted to say he's careful in his work.” Iven scraped a little dried ink off his pen shaft with a fingernail.
pairs.hanzi: “想说他做事很仔细。”伊文用指甲刮去笔杆上一点干墨，

pairs.target: " huàdàozuǐbiān , yòu xiǎngbùqǐ zìjǐ jiàn guò tā zuò nǎ yíjiàn shì . chúle xiàqí . tā xiàqí dǎo hěn zǐxì , zǒng ràng wǒ shū liǎng zǐ . "
pairs.english: “It was on the tip of my tongue, and then I couldn't remember ever seeing him do anything. Except play chess. He was very careful at that. Always beat me by two pieces.”
pairs.hanzi: “话到嘴边，又想不起自己见过他做哪一件事。除了下棋。他下棋倒很仔细，总让我输两子。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le yíxià , yīwén què méi xiào . tā jiāng nà běn yǒu mòdiǎn de cèzǐ chóngxīn fānkāi , kàn le piànkè , shuō :
pairs.english: Tavi laughed briefly, but Iven didn't. He reopened the notebook with the ink dot, studied it a moment, and said:
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了一下，伊文却没笑。他将那本有墨点的册子重新翻开，看了片刻，说：

pairs.target: " yě kěnéng shì wǒ xiǎng ràng tā méiyǒu cuò . wǒ bù xǐhuan nǐmen yì tídào zhèzhǒng rén , jiù juéde wǒ bìdìng rènshi . "
pairs.english: “Maybe I just want him not to have done anything wrong. I don't like it when you lot mention someone like that and assume I must know him.”
pairs.hanzi: “也可能是我想让他没有错。我不喜欢你们一提到这种人，就觉得我必定认识。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi sōngkāi zhuōjiǎo . " wǒ méi zhème xiǎng . "
pairs.english: Tavi let go of the table leg. “I didn't think that.”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维松开桌脚。“我没这么想。”

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . " yīwén shuō dé tài kuài , tíng le yíhuìer , yòu dào , " nǐ méi zhème shuō . "
pairs.english: “I know.” Iven spoke too quickly, paused a while, then added, “You didn't say that.”
pairs.hanzi: “我知道。”伊文说得太快，停了一会儿，又道，“你没这么说。”

pairs.target: wàitou xiè kuāng de xiǎngdòng yìshēng jiē yìshēng . tǎ wéi běnlái xiǎng wèn nà tào qí hòulái qù le nǎlǐ , zhōngjiū méi wèn .
pairs.english: Outside, the sounds of unloading baskets came one after another. Tavi had meant to ask where the chess set had ended up, but never did.
pairs.hanzi: 外头卸筐的响动一声接一声。塔维本来想问那套棋后来去了哪里，终究没问。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ cèzǐ jiá jìn dàizhōng , yào gǎn qù yǔ shī nán hé xià yízhàn de jiāojiē dān . dào ménkǒu , tā huíguò tóu , wèn míngwǎn hái néng bunéng zǒu nàduàn lù .
pairs.english: Iven slipped the notebook into his bag; he had to hurry off to check the next station's handover sheet with Shinan. At the door he turned back and asked if they could still take that walk tomorrow evening.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把册子夹进袋中，要赶去与施南核下一站的交接单。到门口，他回过头，问明晚还能不能走那段路。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō néng , zìjǐ de bān dào xiàwǔ jiéshù . yīwén diǎndiǎntóu , chūqù shí xiǎnxiē zhuàng shàng jì huái bào lái de kōng kuāng , cèshēn ràng le , cái yòu bǎ kuà dài zhuǎn dào bèihòu .
pairs.english: Tavi said yes; his shift ended in the afternoon. Iven nodded as he went out, nearly collided with an empty basket Ji Huai was carrying in, stepped aside, and then swung his shoulder bag round behind him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说能，自己的班到下午结束。伊文点点头，出去时险些撞上纪槐抱来的空筐，侧身让了，才又把挎袋转到背后。
